sources.note: Use mm and N, as given by 100 mm, 1 mm and 18 N m in the brief; torque converts to 18000 N mm.
100 mm cube in x,y,z, z up. Tool origin at minimum corner yields [0,100]^3.
Steel is stated. Isotropic linear elasticity with E=210000 N/mm^2 and nu=0.30 is assumed because grade and elastic constants are unspecified.
Brief specifies 1 mm elements; h=1 mm, 100 x 100 x 100 elements.
Brief states full bottom face z=0 bolted down. Idealize this as a full-face clamp fixing x,y,z translations; bolt details and compliance are unspecified.
Stated 10x10 mm pad centered along top y=0 edge and flush: x=[45,55], y=[0,10], z=100; centroid radius 45 mm. Equal F=18000/(4*45)=100 N. Force +x produces +z torque.
Stated 10x10 mm pad centered along top x=100 edge and flush: x=[90,100], y=[45,55], z=100; centroid radius 45 mm. Equal F=18000/(4*45)=100 N. Force +y produces +z torque.
Stated 10x10 mm pad centered along top y=100 edge and flush: x=[45,55], y=[90,100], z=100; centroid radius 45 mm. Equal F=18000/(4*45)=100 N. Force -x produces +z torque.

Stated 10x10 mm pad centered along top x=0 edge and flush: x=[0,10], y=[45,55], z=100; centroid radius 45 mm. Equal F=18000/(4*45)=100 N. Force -y produces +z torque. Pad loads distributed equally among selected nodes; no passive pad thickness is introduced because none is specified.

final: DONE — Assumptions: isotropic steel with E = 210 GPa and ν = 0.30; fully clamped bottom; pads modeled as surface loads without passive volumes. Four 100 N forces produce +18 N·m. Validation passed, render confirmed placement, and every item is source-tagged.
